basic_info.description: Situated in highly desirable lower Pacific Heights, this charming and sophisticated 2 level condominium is bathed in natural sunlight. This top floor home boasts tall ceilings and an elegant, formal living room with period details. The updated kitchen has a breakfast nook and door to a shared deck - perfect for a BBQ. The main level has a full bath and 2nd bedroom. The top floor primary suite is a secluded haven with a gas fireplace, walk-in closet and en-suite bath. In addition you can enjoy your own private roof top deck with views to downtown and twin peaks. Additional amenities include in-unit laundry and 1 car independent parking. The building also enjoys low HOA dues. Enjoy the best of San Francisco living with easy walk to Fillmore Street, Alta Plaza Park, The Presidio, Laurel Village and Sacramento Street shopping + dining. This property currently has tenants in it.  First 5 photos are virtually staged.
